## Install or update

Install **QuackWrangler** from the
[VS Code Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=quackwrangler.quackwrangler),
or update it from the Extensions view in VS Code.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage`
- [ ] `npm run build:production`
- [ ] `npx vsce ls --tree` contains no source, tests, coverage, or benchmark data
- [ ] `npm audit --omit=dev`
- [ ] VSIX installed and smoke-tested in an Extension Development Host
- [ ] Remote HTTPS/S3 progress and error states checked
- [ ] Dark and light VS Code themes checked
- [ ] Screenshot or GIF included for visible changes

See the complete [release QA checklist](https://github.com/mohsinsurani/quackwrangler/blob/main/docs/QA_CHECKLIST.md).
